{{Top|leg}}
A '''cutting block''' was used by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] to sacrifice someone's body part to their [[Yun'o|gods]]. [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]] was going to sacrifice his left [[hand]] in preparation for the [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|Battle of Borleia]], but decided instead to sacrifice his whole [[Limb/Legends|arm]], and replaced it with a [[radank]] claw.
